Unix 秒；来自缓存时是缓存写入时刻: Unix seconds; when served from cache, this is the time the cache was written
true = 忽略实现侧缓存，真拉一次上游: true = bypass the implementation's cache and actually fetch from upstream once
与上游同集；0 条视同失败（消费侧纪律：判据是「解析得出条目」不是调用成功）: Same set as upstream; 0 entries counts as a failure (consumer-side discipline: the criterion is "entries were parsed out", not "the call succeeded")
价格三档/上下文与输出上限/能力位/模态的全量表；平台的「匹配单价」与跟随开关吃: The full table of the three price tiers / context and output limits / capability flags / modalities; the platform's "matched unit price" and follow-the-model switches consume this
如 http://host:port；插件所在网络到不了 GitHub 时配（也: e.g. http://host:port; set this when the network the plugin runs on can't reach GitHub (or deploy the plugin directly on a machine that can)
模型元数据表（litellm 社区表）：价格/上限/能力位/模态。平台「模型元数: The model metadata table (LiteLLM community table): prices / limits / capability flags / modalities. This is the platform's built-in default implementation for the "model metadata" slot — rebind it to switch data sources.
真去取一次价格表（不吃缓存），报条目数与数据来源: Actually fetches the price table once (bypassing the cache) and reports the entry count and data source
真拉时是命中的 URL；缓存命中时是 cache: The URL that was hit on a real fetch; "cache" when served from cache
逗号分隔的价目表 JSON 地址；留空用 litellm 官方源 + 两个镜像。: Comma-separated price-table JSON URLs; leave empty to use LiteLLM's official source plus two mirrors. If you maintain your own price table, enter its URL to switch sources
